questions.title: Which country will end China's gold-medal bid in men's football at the 2026 Asian Games?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official 2026 Asian Games men's football results, corroborated by reliable match reporting. Resolution : Identify the opposing national team in the match that eliminates China from contention for the men's football gold medal. Any subsequent bronze-medal match is excluded. If China wins gold, resolve to no country. Accepted Answer Format : The opposing country's name, or “None” if China wins gold.
questions.current_reasoning: Sharp 2026-09-28 odds & squad update 2 days before Wednesday Sept 30 Asian Games men's football semifinals in Osaka (South Korea vs China 15:00 JST, Uzbekistan vs Japan 19:30 JST; Yonhap, Korea Times, SBS, Zhibo8/Football News, MHN Sports, Bongda, Betimate, Al Jazeera Sept 28). Live Sept 28 Betimate sportsbook feeds show South Korea U23 steaming sharply from 1.42 / Draw 4.20 / China 6.70 (vig-free 90m ~66.1%/21.0%/12.9%, knockout advance ~79.5% Korea) to 1.331-1.333 / Draw 4.42-4.44 / China 8.78-8.81 (vig-free 90m ~70.7%/19.7%/9.6%, knockout advance ~82.6-84.9% Korea; O/U rising 2.5 -> 2.75). Squad and rest news strongly corroborates the market move: South Korea boasts 9 Europe-based pros including 3 WC26 players (Eom Ji-sung, Yang Hyun-jun, Bae Jun-ho) plus Kim Ji-soo, Yang Min-hyeok, Park Seung-soo, Lee Young-jun, Kim Myeong-jun, and Lee Hyun-ju; has 10 GF / 1 GA across 3 games with 5 full days rest; rested Eom Ji-sung (ankle knock 100% cleared), Yang Hyun-jun, and Lee Seung-won in Friday's 4-0 QF over Vietnam; holds a 5-0 Asian Games H2H over China; and plays for military-service exemption. China's coach Antonio Puche called Korea 'top 3 in Asia—very strong' and said China will try to 'create a miracle.' Still, shrinking slightly from the steamed ~83.7% market implied rate to South Korea 0.80 (0.72 -> 0.80) accounts for thinner Asian Games U-23 market liquidity, China's elite 5-3-2 low block (8 clean sheets in 10 2026 competitive games, 1 GA in 4 Asiad matches) with Wang Yudong returning from suspension, and Typhoon Surigae's projected midweek rain/wind threat toward central Japan (Al Jazeera/Straits Times Sept 28) which can compress scoring and elevate ET/penalty variance. In SF2, live Sept 28 Betimate odds (Uzbekistan 3.43, Draw 3.32, Japan 2.01) price host Japan at ~61% to advance over Uzbekistan (~39%). Conditional on a 20% China upset over South Korea—and noting host Japan beat this China core 4-0 in the Jan 2026 U-23 Asian Cup Final (~68% Japan / ~60% Uzbekistan over China in an Oct 3 Final)—the exhaustive 4-outcome lock updates to South Korea 0.80, Japan 0.08 (0.09 -> 0.08, overtaking None), None (China wins gold) 0.07 (0.11 -> 0.07), and Uzbekistan 0.05 (0.08 -> 0.05).
